body: A fresh battery and field radio are wrapped together. Red field grit fills the speaker; county warning tape covers the tuning dial.
title: field radio wrapped in warning tape
gloss: Field residue and response material share one ambiguous bundle.
rival_reading: Field workers and emergency responders could each have made this mixed bundle; it does not settle which activity came first.

title: Between two songs
body: A road crew passed the gathering and said there would be transport at daylight. The handwritten passenger list filled before the first vehicle arrived. The musicians kept playing so the people at the far end would not hear the argument.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
